caveat: A replicate of run 3: same pair (egress-vetting to command-vetting), configuration and sampling settings; each run has its own source run, so the carried harness and memory differ (run 3: 2 accepted edits, run 4: 3). Run 3's ordering of the arms was not reproduced: in run 4 cold start, harness transfer, problem-only and full SIM all end at 0.93 to 0.97 on the 30 target held-out tasks, and cold start, which stayed at 0.50 in run 3, reaches 0.93. The same arm differs between the two runs by up to 0.43; the arms differ from each other by at most 0.04 in run 4. The evaluator itself is not deterministic at temperature 0 (the same seed harness scored 0.67 and 0.77 on the same source tasks). No arm can be called better or worse from these two runs.
reasons: a replicate of run 3 with the same configuration
the arms are not distinguishable from run-to-run variation
the evaluator is not deterministic at temperature 0 (up to 3 tasks on one held-out set)
the starting harness differs between runs because each run has its own source run
evolve set saturated in all optimized arms
